de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface ReadableBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BaseReadableBuffer, Buffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    AddBuffer, CharactBarBuffer, DbObjectBuffer, GlobalTextBuffer, LoadableBuffer, LoadBuffer, LockableBuffer, ParentScreenBuffer, PrintBuffer, ScreenBuffer, ScreenEnabledBuffer, SelectableBuffer, SelectBarBuffer, SelectBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, TableModifiableBuffer, TextBuffer, UserTextBuffer, WriteableBuffer

    public interface ReadableBuffer
extends BaseReadableBuffer
    Any FO buffer which contains database data and from which values may be read implements this interface. So this interface just defines database read access.

      • loadAddBuffer

        AddBuffer loadAddBuffer(String referenceField)
                 throws FOPException
        Creates and loads an add buffer instance from a reference field.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are

        • german: 
          .DAZU
        • english: 
          .ADD

        Parameters:
        referenceField - The field name.
        Returns:
        The add buffer instance with the reference field's record loaded.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If the field is no reference field.

      • getRefFieldBuffer

        ReadableBuffer getRefFieldBuffer(String refField)
        Gets a readable buffer representation for the reference field refField in an already loaded buffer.
        This the FO join operation ^.
        Further access to the resulting ReadableBuffer will just build a join expression and return the resulting values. Buffer.getName() will return an expression like H|field.
        Therefore buffer instances created here become invalid when this instance is unloaded!
        Parameters:
        refField - The reference field.
        Returns:
        The readable buffer.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • getTempFileName

        String getTempFileName(String field)
                throws FOPException
        Reads a field (DVM2, TN, text field) and interprets it as a filename. If it contains a free text name, the contents is copied to a temporary file. it it is empty, a temporary file of an empty file is returned. otherwise the field content is returned.

        Some information concerning the encoding:

        No encoding conversion takes place. Except for non free text fields like GL, T etc. The values of these fields will be delivered with the S3 encoding.

        This method does not work in a remote context!

        if the field is empty the function creates an empty temporary file

        Parameters:
        field - The field name
        Returns:
        The temporary file name of a file which contains the field content
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • getReader

        Reader getReader(String field)
          throws FOPException
        Reads a free text field (TN or DVM2) with a java.io.Reader instance. Technically the following procedure will take place:
        • Create temporary file representation of the contents by calling .SELECT FROM field
        • Create server side working copy of the contents
        • Create java.io.Reader with S3 encoding
        • Read contents
        • Delete file on close
        Take care of closing the reader. Otherwise temporary files may remain on the disk.

        This method does not work in a remote context!

        Parameters:
        field - The field name
        Returns:
        The reader instance or null if the field is empty.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.

      • getOldValue

        String getOldValue(String field)
            throws FOPException
        Provides the original value of the variable. This is always empty string for new data records. After saving it returns the same result as getStringValue(). (A raw (unformatted, internal) String value.) Reference objects are not supported (^ linking).
        Parameters:
        field - The field name
        Returns:
        The string value of original value of the variable.
        Throws:
        FOPException - If an error occurs.
